events.event_name: Cafe Yaeji: Free Oatly Gochujang Lattes
events.what_it_is: A two-day Korean dabang-inspired immersive cafe created by Oatly and artist/producer Yaeji.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with espresso, Oatly Barista Edition, gochujang-vanilla base and salted vanilla cold foam.
events.caveats: Public sources describe the cafe as open to visitors and do not establish an advance RSVP requirement. Complimentary drinks are promotional and may be subject to supply/capacity.
events.practical_notes: September 19 and 20, 9 AM–3 PM each day at 48 Ludlow Street.

events.what_it_is: A two-day Brown Bee collaboration at Pura Vida Nolita.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests can receive a PB smoothie, a full-size Brown Bee product and an exclusive Brown Bee gift.
events.caveats: Free items are limited to the first 100 guests; availability is while supplies last. No advance RSVP requirement is published.
events.practical_notes: September 18–19, 10 AM–6 PM daily at Pura Vida Nolita, 98 Kenmare Street.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first cafe-and-retail pop-up celebrating Mocha Magic fragrance with cafe-inspired drinks, fragrance sampling and merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Cafe drinks/fragrance sampling are promoted; the first 50 people in line each day receive a special gift.
events.caveats: A secondary event source advertises a free RSVP, but does not establish RSVP as required for admission. Special gifts are limited to the first 50 guests each day; gifts with purchase are separate.
events.practical_notes: September 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily at 262 Mott Street.
